The role exists to maximise the CPO's capacity to focus on strategic priorities by autonomously managing administrative and logistical requirements with a high degree of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality. As a trusted partner, the Executive Assistant will facilitate effective communication, maintain strong stakeholder relationships, support the preparation and coordination of key meetings and governance processes, and contribute to knowledge management across the department. In addition, the role will support wider People team initiatives, including onboarding new direct reports of the CPO, fostering departmental connectivity and engagement, and helping to coordinate departmental activities that strengthen organisational effectiveness. Through exceptional organisation, collaboration, and attention to detail, this role contributes to the successful delivery of the People strategy and, ultimately, Save the Children's mission and objectives. Prepare agendas, briefing packs, presentations, reports, and correspondence to a consistently high standard, ensuring the CPO is fully prepared for meetings and engagements. Process invoices and procurement-related transactions within delegated budgets, ensuring adherence to financial controls, procurement requirements, and organisational policies. Maintain accurate departmental distribution lists, contact databases, records, and information management systems to support effective communication and knowledge sharing across the People function. Build strong and collaborative relationships with Executive Assistants and support staff across the organisation, ensuring effective coordination, cover arrangements, and alignment of leadership activities. Support departmental recognition and appreciation activities, helping to promote a culture of inclusion, wellbeing, collaboration, and celebration across the People function. Maintain awareness of key People priorities, initiatives, and organisational developments, ensuring the CPO is supported with relevant information and that departmental activities remain aligned to strategic objectives. Contribute to the continuous improvement of departmental processes, administrative systems, and ways of working to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and service delivery across the People team. Proven experience managing complex and frequently changing diaries, coordinating meetings across multiple time zones, and balancing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrable experience managing high-volume inboxes, exercising sound judgement to prioritise, redirect and respond appropriately to communications on behalf of senior leaders. Extensive experience planning and coordinating complex domestic and international travel arrangements, including visas, accommodation, itineraries and logistics. Experience in supporting meetings instigated by the CPO, including agenda preparation, coordination of papers, minute-taking and action tracking. Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously while maintaining high levels of accuracy and attention to detail. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft, edit and proofread a wide range of documents, presentations, reports and correspondence to a professional standard. Demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information with discretion, professionalism and sound judgement. Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues, senior leaders and external partners at all levels. Proven ability to work independently, anticipate needs, identify potential issues and implement practical solutions in a proactive manner. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Teams and Excel, together with confidence working across a range of digital collaboration and business systems. Comfortable learning and using organisational systems and technologies, including financial management, procurement, travel booking and workflow management platforms. Strong digital confidence and a willingness to embrace new technologies, including an interest in leveraging AI and digital tools to improve productivity, efficiency and ways of working. Desirable Experience supporting a Chief People Officer, HR Director, or equivilent within a People or Human Resources function. Experience working within a complex, global, matrixed or international organisation. Familiarity with People (HR) practices, organisational development, employee engagement or culture-related activities. Experience of working within a charity An interest in the work undertaken by Save the Children International. Education and Qualifications Essential Educated to degree level and/or holds a relevant professional qualification, or equivalent experience Desirable Evidence of continuing professional development relevant to executive support, administration, business operations or governance. The work here is challenging but is also immensely rewarding. At Save the Children, you will be in good company, working with talented, like-minded individuals who are determined to ensure that all children survive, learn, and are protected. Your contribution will help ensure children's voices are heard at the highest levels, and that we achieve our global strategy, Ambition for Children 2030 , and reach every last child. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and Equal Opportunities DEI is core to our vision, values and global strategy. Save the Children is committed to creating a truly diverse, equitable and inclusive organisation, and one which will support us in our vision to ensure every child attains the right to survival, protection, development, and participation. Project Overview The Integrated Innovation Highway (IIH) is a Gates Foundation-funded initiative supporting the Government of Ethiopia and the Ministry of Health to establish a government-owned platform that systematically identifies health system needs, prioritizes innovations, assesses evidence and readiness, and supports the introduction, transition, and scale-up of innovations within the Ethiopian health system. The IIH promotes an integrated approach across six innovation highways: medical devices; diagnostics; therapeutics, family planning, and nutrition products; vaccines; technology, including digital health, artificial intelligence, and biotechnology; and bundled and systems innovations. Phase 1 focuses on AI-enabled point-of-care ultrasound (AI-POCUS) under the Medical Device Highway, alongside near-point-of-care TB PlusLife and Ebola diagnostics under the Diagnostics Highway. The Medical Device Highway will support government-led assessment, procurement planning, introduction, implementation, and transition-to-scale of priority medical device innovations, with AI-POCUS as a principal initial focus. A key implementation priority is the coordinated procurement, facility readiness assessment, deployment, and operationalization of 50 obstetric AI-enabled point-of-care ultrasound (OB AI-POCUS) units across selected primary health care units (PHCUs) in Oromia, Sidama, and Somali regions. The Lead will also facilitate government and manufacturer engagement, including engagement through the CEO Round Table (CEORT), to support equipment availability, technical assistance, installation, training, maintenance, and transition-to-scale planning. Translate national medical device priorities into implementation plans, technical guidance, deliverables, milestones, budgets, and measurable performance indicators. Starat se o naše návštěvy , aby se u nás každý host cítil vítaný a bylo o něj rychle a s úsměvem postaráno. Pečovat o kolegy , aby měli včas všechny potřebné a funkční pracovní pomůcky – objednávka počítačů, vstupních čipů, jejich výměna apod. Starat se o vozový park – včas domluvený servis (včetně odvozu do servisu a zpět), nablýskaná auta a knihy jízd v pořádku. Udržovat kanceláře , aby se v nich všichni cítili dobře – potřebné vybavení i dostatek občerstvení v lednicích. Spravovat svěřené rozpočty – předvídat, co a kdy nakoupit do zásoby, vybírat dodavatele a navrhovat, co zlepšit nebo zjednodušit. CO OD TEBE OČEKÁVÁME? Ideálně min. SŠ vzdělání. Alespoň 2 roky zkušeností na obdobné pozici – tady se bez nich neobejdeš. Komunikační dovednosti slovem i písmem, v češtině i angličtině. Příjemné vystupování, aby se k Tobě lidé rádi vraceli. B – a radost z toho, že si zajezdíš třeba velkým Mercedesem. CO ZÍSKÁŠ NEBO CO U NÁS MŮŽEŠ ZAŽÍT? 5 týdnů dovolené Odpočinek je důležitý. Proto pro tebe máme 5 týdnů dovolené. Před každým mergem ti náš GitLab bot zkontroluje kód (aktuálně běží na modelu Claude Sonnet), takže se vyhneš zbytečným chybám.
